crossRefs.note: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

translations.web: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.
translations.bsb: It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.
translations.kjv: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
translations.asv: That is the thing which I spake unto Pharaoh: what God is about to do he hath showed unto Pharaoh.
